summary: (Third commit: review fixes - manual refresh shares the per-project guard, records the completion time, skips distractor runs, first-launch fetch is recorded; the generate-button hint only when a newly linked paper is recommendable (new_recommendable); sources_disabled and year-in-line nits. Second commit: toast points at the generate button when today's batch exists; maintenance status gains batch_today.) Every successful refresh (automatic and the 抓取新论文 button) is recorded per project with its time, papers fetched and papers new to the project; the home page shows it under the button ("最近抓取 10-23 18:44 · 抓到 33 篇，新 10 篇"), and the toast reports the same counts instead of `added`, which only counts rows new to the whole library and so read 0 whenever the papers were already stored.
scope_note: Worktree refresh-record from main 9c448a3. Additive response fields (refresh result: new_to_project; /api/home maintenance: last_refresh_result); a manual refresh now also sets last_refresh, which moves the next automatic refresh (intended: a manual fetch counts as the day's fetch). No migration: the record is one settings key per project (last_refresh_result_<project>), removed with the project. The files list is the third commit's change set (fixes after the independent review; earlier commits e054285 and 1a5041e).

budget_impact.rationale: Local bookkeeping and presentation; no model call, no extra request, no data leaves the machine.
budget_impact.before: toast 新增 N 条 (rows new to the library); the manual button did not update last_refresh; no record of a fetch
budget_impact.after: toast and a line under the button give fetched / new-to-project; a manual fetch is recorded

reviews.reviewer: Separate review agent (Opus), read-only, of e054285+1a5041e: no blocking issue; two should-fix items and three nits, fixed in the third commit

open_risks: Not looked at in a browser: the line is checked in a Node virtual page only.
A manual refresh still does not rebuild the visible list; the toast now points at the generate button when a batch already exists today (no automatic batch build).
The independent review covered the first two commits; the third commit's fixes have only the implementer's self-review.
new_recommendable on a learning map counts unrated, readable, dated papers (build_batch's route pool) and ignores whether the frontier would pick them.
